grad: GPA first: spread hard courses across quarters — never stack two killers together
Take 1–2 graduate-level courses; it helps grad/PhD applications
Find research for credit (199 courses) — worth more than one extra class
job: Project courses first: prioritize what goes on your résumé
Keep the two recruiting-season quarters light — leave time for interviews
Clear prerequisites early; prioritize the tech-stack courses internships ask for
undecided: Plan by degree requirements first; spread the hard courses
Decide by end of sophomore year: the two paths diverge at upper-division courses
